overview: Akheva Ruins are the shattered remains of the ancient Akhevan empire.
history: Once a thriving alien civilization, the Akheva fell when void resonance ruptured their temporal lattice. Their constructs and priesthood remain, bound to ancient directives.
hooks: A void storm sweeps through the outer sanctum.
Temporal fractures destabilize the Xi Vius halls.
A resonance pulse opens a passage toward Vex Thal.
